answer: An alias is not free: 95 POA and 18 minutes buys one, and 632 of them cost 60040 POA and 11376 minutes. Every honest agent brings a haven from the bench, a timber from the purse, and a violet from the hall, and the panel checks all three before a word is graded. A farm falls at the first real check when the check is Licensed carpenter joint cutting record with trade council attestation, which demands 6-year apprenticeship, 138 supervised frames, trade test, guild dues from every applicant. The honest road is short; the farm's road is long, costly, and watched at every step.
